spec-1.text: [important] `scripts/wiki-reciprocate-backlinks.py:140,165-169,189-191` against `scripts/wiki-lint-mechanical.py:288-297,320-321` — the lint and the rebuild find the block in different text, so a page with an unclosed fence before its block is listed "missing" for every linker on every cycle. Intent: plan Step 2: "after one rebuild, the lint's new section lists nothing on the test notebook"; red-team #4 kill criterion: "any page listed after a rebuild on a real notebook". Implemented: the lint runs `text = backlink_prose(f.read_text(...))` then `BACKLINK_BLOCK_RE.search(text)`; `backlink_prose` drops everything after an unclosed fence, so a block after that fence is invisible. The rebuild reads the raw text and, with no block found, appends one (`new_text = text + "\n" + new_block + "\n"`), after the fence. Affected: notebook owners; Needs you fires every cycle and points at the script though the rebuild's output is correct; the block also sits inside the fence and does not render. Fix: run the rebuild's block search and append through the same code-stripped view (or skip and report such a page); add a test: page with an unclosed fence plus one linker, one rebuild, lint lists nothing. Same root cause, second case (pre-existing in the rebuild): a START quoted in backticks before a real block: the raw regex at line 165 spans from the quoted START to the real END and replaces the text between, while the lint sees only the real block. checkpoints.md's "code is stripped before blocks are found (both scripts…)" holds for link reading and the lint only.
